0022600093.text: The Kings open their 2026-27 season as the away team at the LA Clippers, and neither team has played a game yet this season. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, ruptured), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and is a game-time decision. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and the teams' 2025-26 season series ended with the Kings losing 1-3, including a 138-109 Kings loss in Sacramento on April 5, 2026.
